data.name: NextWorld2
data.detailed_description:
NextWorld2 is a Hungarian-developed fantasy MMORPG featuring an open world, fast-paced combat, mount collection, and deep character progression. Built on a custom graphics engine, the game welcomes thousands of players daily to explore the continent of Kigan, where the kingdoms of Selakim and Quila clash in an ongoing power struggle.

Key Features

Four Playable Classes, Each with Two Specializations

Choose from four distinct classes:

  • Warrior (Inquisitor, Protector)

  • Ninja (Shadowblade, Marksman)

  • Ezra (Doomlord, Dark Mage)

  • Shaman (Stormborn, Dragonborn)

Each class offers unique playstyles, stat builds, and a dedicated skill tree.

Real-Time, Dynamic Combat System

  • Fast and visually striking melee and magic attacks

  • PvE and PvP modes

  • Ability combos, buffs, debuffs, and area-of-effect spells

  • Specialization-based combat variations

Open World and Questing

  • A freely explorable fantasy world with multiple regions

  • Choose your kingdom at the start of the game

  • Beginner tutorial quests teaching movement, combat, equipment, and mount usage

  • Regular content updates and expanding world features

Mount Collection and Progression

One of the core systems of NextWorld2 is mount collection:

  • Ground and flying mounts

  • Upgradeable stats

  • Account-wide bonuses that apply to all characters

  • Rare, event-exclusive mounts

Equipment and Enhancement

  • Stone socketing, forging, and crafting systems

  • Strengthening equipment and adding new attributes

  • Frequent boss and dungeon rewards

  • Various costumes and pets that grant additional bonuses

Economy and Marketplace

  • Main currency: Gold (Gold Bars)

  • The Goldur Trading House serves as the central marketplace for player-to-player trading

  • A fully community-driven economy based on supply and demand

PvE Content

  • Diverse monsters across the world

  • Dungeons (runs) with varying difficulty

  • World bosses and minibosses

  • Seasonal events with unique rewards

data.short_description: A free-to-play fantasy MMORPG set in the world of Kigan, where two great kingdoms clash as darkness rises once more. Choose your allegiance, fight legendary creatures, and uncover the secret of the Demon Regent’s return.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2125 3.3GHz / AMD Phenom II X4 3.3GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R9 270 / Intel UHD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support:
  • Additional Notes: Windows-compatible mouse

  • Additional Notes: Windows-compatible mouse
